summary: Admit reserved notice facts through graph-designated runtime and immutable authenticated source lineage.

replay.detail: Custom folding validates notice authors, exact registrations and immutable source links. Mandatory source-subject and pinned-creation dependencies persist independently of optional basis inputs, including pending and invalid rows; later source arrivals or conflicts revalidate linked snapshots and controls. Missing, duplicated or mismatched bindings fail closed. Historical admission cuts and revocation ordering are not implemented here.

schema.detail: One live agent may declare the bare notice-runtime graph role. A graph apply leaving a second live holder is refused.

rules.detail: Existing graph publishers may designate the runtime. Only that authenticated actor writes snapshots; only the independently resolved source recipient, a person, writes controls. Payload actor fields never confer authority.

compatibility.detail: Generic raw notice reads remain denied. Native recipient-authorized views and typed controls are not exposed by this slice. Mixed-version or dependency gaps cannot fall back to generic notice reads on upgraded members.

manual.detail: Designate exactly one notice runtime and register the reviewed manifests before local notice fact admission.

recovery.detail: Restore a unique live designation and reviewed registration dependencies. Runtime handover provenance, partition conflict admission, revocation and replay ordering require B2 before publication rollout.
